company.name: 健立生醫股份有限公司

description.text:
▎Design, develop, and maintain backend services and APIs underpinning all five product lines
▎Build healthcare data ingestion, transformation, and exchange pipelines, including intra-hospital system integrationand cross-institution data exchange
▎Develop imaging transfer, routing, storage, and lifecycle management services
▎Integrate commercial and open-source LLM inference into clinical and administrative workflows, with correspondingevaluation and monitoring systems
▎Optimize for high-throughput, low-latency, and high-availability requirements; diagnose and resolve productionissues
▎Share rotational ownership of production database operations: backup verification and restore drills, replication andfailover, capacity planning, index and query health, and version upgrades
▎Participate in code reviews, technical documentation, and architecture discussions
▎Implement data privacy, audit trails, and access controls appropriate to a regulated healthcare data environment
【BASIC QUALIFICATIONS】
▎3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
▎2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existingsystems experience
▎Strong proficiency in at least two of: Java, C/C++, Python, or TypeScript/Node.js, with demonstrated ownership ofproduction code
▎Experience designing and consuming RESTful APIs, including authentication, versioning, error handling, and ratelimiting
▎Hands-on experience with relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL), including schema design, indexing, andquery optimization; familiarity with at least one NoSQL store
▎Practical experience with Redis or an equivalent in-memory store for caching, session management, rate limiting,or distributed locking
▎Experience with event-driven architectures and message brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka, or equivalent), includingasynchronous job processing, retry and dead-letter handling
▎Experience with at least one major cloud platform (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and containerized deployment
▎Proficiency with Git-based workflows (branching strategy, code review, conflict resolution) and hands-on experiencebuilding or maintaining CI/CD pipelines
▎Strong hands-on Linux expertise, with the ability to independently diagnose system-level issues (processes,memory, disk, networking, permissions, services) and write shell scripts
▎Professional reading proficiency in English, sufficient to work directly from technical specifications, standardsdocuments (HL7, FHIR, DICOM), vendor documentation, and open-source codebases
▎Working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese for team collaboration, technical documentation, and requirementdiscussions
▎Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, ▎Mathematics, Information Management,or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
